gloss: day and night; morning and evening; all day long

definitions.gloss: day and night; morning and evening; all day long
definitions.explanation: Expresses the idea of doing something continuously from dawn to dusk, emphasizing constant, tireless activity without rest.

definitions.gloss: to be absorbed in; to spend all one's time doing
definitions.explanation: Used with に to indicate what one is absorbed in.

examples.japanese: {明|あ}け{暮|く}れ{勉強|べんきょう}している。
{明|あ}け{暮|く}れ{仕事|しごと}に{追|お}われている。
examples.english: I'm chased by work from morning to night.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{明|あ}け{暮|く}れ{練習|れんしゅう}に{励|はげ}んでいた。
examples.english: He devoted himself to practice day in and day out.

examples.japanese: {読書|どくしょ}に{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる。
examples.english: To be absorbed in reading all the time.

examples.japanese: {研究|けんきゅう}に{明|あ}け{暮|く}れた{日々|ひび}だった。
examples.english: Those were days spent completely absorbed in research.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}は{遊|あそ}びに{明|あ}け{暮|く}れていた。
examples.english: When I was young, I spent all my time having fun.

notes:
Combines {明|あ}け (dawn) and {暮|く}れ (dusk) to mean "from dawn to dusk" or "all day long." As an adverb (sense 1), it modifies verbs to indicate constant, tireless activity. As a verb with する (sense 2), it takes the pattern ～に{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる to mean being completely absorbed in something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {明|あ}け{暮|く}れ + verb: to do something all day long
- ～に{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる: to be absorbed in; to spend all one's time on

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}に{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる: to be consumed by work
- {勉強|べんきょう}に{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる: to study constantly
- {遊|あそ}びに{明|あ}け{暮|く}れる: to do nothing but have fun

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日夜|にちや}: day and night — more formal; often used in written language
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}: day and night — similar to {日夜|にちや}; more neutral
